name: DCloud public quality, system, and business audit

coordinate_model.O: official public URL + unauthenticated state + observation time
coordinate_model.Z: raw public response first; rendered desktop/mobile confirmation later
coordinate_model.T: navigation -> settled response -> evidence normalization -> human judgment

targets.role: legacy contact surface on canonical domain

findings.title: Unfinished team template remains publicly reachable on the canonical domain
findings.quality_lens: Public content integrity and release hygiene failure.
findings.system_lens: Published-page inventory and retirement controls do not reliably exclude stale Tilda assets.
findings.business_lens: A candidate or client can encounter unrelated Badoo, Finland, placeholder staff, and template vacancy content, reducing trust.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm visible impact in settled desktop and mobile browser captures before CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT.

findings.title: Legacy and current contact identities conflict on the same canonical domain
findings.quality_lens: Conflicting contact data and copyright years are simultaneously public.
findings.system_lens: Contact identity is duplicated across independently maintained pages instead of one governed source.
findings.business_lens: Leads and candidates may use an obsolete email, phone, address, or domain and abandon contact.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm browser visibility and link/index discoverability before assigning final user-impact severity.

findings.title: QA vacancy mixes working-time, developer-interview, and QA role models
findings.quality_lens: The page contains internally inconsistent or role-incongruent wording.
findings.system_lens: Vacancy templates appear copied across disciplines without typed content constraints.
findings.business_lens: Qualified QA candidates may misread workload, seniority, and interview expectations, lowering conversion.
findings.promotion_rule: Human review must distinguish intentional hiring policy from template leakage.

findings.title: Multiple specialist roles reuse the Backend/Fullstack Team Lead description
findings.quality_lens: Role labels and role descriptions are semantically mismatched.
findings.system_lens: The content model lacks per-role required fields and duplication checks.
findings.business_lens: Customers and candidates receive a weaker signal of actual multidisciplinary expertise.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm card-to-description mapping in rendered layout.

findings.title: English commercial copy contains repeated mistranslation and placeholder-like terminology
findings.quality_lens: Visible English copy contains spelling, grammar, and semantic quality signals.
findings.system_lens: Localization lacks an editorial acceptance gate and source-language parity checks.
findings.business_lens: International prospects may infer weak delivery quality from the public English storefront.
findings.promotion_rule: Native-speaker review and rendered context are required for final wording judgment.
